content.short: UTONIC is a TON restaking protocol designed to extend staked TON security into additional network services.
content.description: UTONIC focuses on restaking for The Open Network. The project positions itself as TON restaking infrastructure, where staked assets can help support additional services or security layers beyond ordinary staking. UTONIC belongs in TON DeFi because its main workflow gives users a way to trade, earn, borrow, stake, or manage liquidity through an actual product surface. UTONIC gives TON users a practical path to deploy capital, route trades, manage liquidity, or interact with DeFi positions.
